Definition: support or (by implication) ability, i.e. (direct) help, (in purpose) an undertaking, (intellectual) understanding
BiblicalUsage: 1) wisdom, sound knowledge, success, sound or efficient wisdom, abiding success; 1a) sound or efficient wisdom; 1b) abiding success (of the effect of sound wisdom)
